concept_uz: 1771-yil, Sankt-Peterburg, yongʻin. Deyarli koʻr boʻlib qolgan Leonard Eylerni uydan olib chiqishadi — lekin u ishlashdan toʻxtamaydi: oʻgʻliga aytib yozdiradi. Qoʻlida yogʻoch kub, barmoqlari bilan sanaydi: 8 − 12 + 6 = 2. Piramidada ham 2! Oxirida tomoshabinga savol.

facts.claim: 1771-yil Sankt-Peterburgda katta yongʻin boʻlgan, deyarli koʻr Eylerni yonayotgan uydan olib chiqishgan
Taxminan 1738-yilda oʻng koʻzi koʻrmay qolgan, 1771-yilga kelib katarakta tufayli deyarli butunlay koʻr boʻlgan
Koʻr boʻlgach formulalarni xayolida tuzib, oʻgʻillari va yordamchilariga aytib yozdirgan
Umri davomida 800 dan ortiq ishi chiqqan
U − Q + Y = 2: kub 8 − 12 + 6 = 2, uchburchakli piramida 4 − 6 + 4 = 2; teshigi yoʻq koʻpyoqda doim 2
Savol javobi: asosi kvadrat piramida — 5 uch, 8 qirra → 5 − 8 + Y = 2 → Y = 5

style_line: Cinematic photoreal historical drama, 18th-century Saint Petersburg, candlelight and warm amber firelight, deep blue night shadows, 35mm film look, soft grain, respectful reconstruction. No text, no letters, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 wide shot of a snowy cobbled street in 18th-century Saint Petersburg at night: tall stone townhouses with many small windows, a distant orange glow and smoke rising over the rooftops several streets away, a horse cart, lanterns, a church bell tower silhouette. No people. No signs, no writing.

Vertical 9:16 waist-up portrait, respectful historical reconstruction, of the Swiss mathematician Leonhard Euler in 1771, aged about 64: round kind face, soft double chin, a cream-coloured cloth cap wrapped like a soft turban on his head, a dark green quilted dressing gown over a white shirt with a loose cravat; his eyes are clouded and gaze gently past the camera, the RIGHT eye noticeably paler. Warm candlelight, calm wise half-smile.

Vertical 9:16 waist-up portrait of a man about 37 in 1770s European dress: brown frock coat, white shirt, a plain black ribbon tying back his powdered grey hair, an ink-stained quill tucked behind his LEFT ear, attentive patient face, holding a sheaf of paper. Warm candlelight.

Vertical 9:16 interior of an 18th-century scholar's study at night: a heavy wooden writing desk with inkwell, quills and stacks of blank paper, a brass candelabra, bookshelves, a tiled stove, a small wooden cube and a small wooden triangular pyramid on the desk. No people. No writing on the papers.

Combine the attached images into one vertical 9:16 shot on the same snowy street at night: the son in the brown coat gently leads the old man in the cream cloth cap and green dressing gown out of a doorway by the arm, wrapping a blanket around his shoulders; the orange glow and smoke are far behind them over the rooftops, nobody is hurt. Same faces, same night light.

Combine the attached images into one vertical 9:16 shot in the same study: the son sits at the desk with a quill over a blank page, looking up; the old man in the cream cloth cap stands beside him, one hand raised as he speaks, his clouded eyes looking into the distance. Same faces, warm candlelight.

Change the scene: close-up of the old man in the cream cloth cap holding the small wooden cube in both hands near his face, fingertips resting on its corners, eyes closed in concentration, a faint smile. The son blurred behind him. Same face, same candlelight, 9:16.

lines.text: Bir ming yetti yuz yetmish birinchi yil. Sankt-Peterburgda katta yongʻin.

scenes.prompt: Urgent opening: church bells ring, the son hurries the old man out of the doorway into the snow, wrapping the blanket around him; the orange glow pulses far over the rooftops. No flames near them, nobody hurt. Audio: loud alarm bells, distant crackle, shouts far away, crunching snow. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, deep, warm Uzbek male narrator voice: "Bir ming yetti yuz yetmish birinchi yil. Sankt-Peterburgda katta yong'in." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Koʻzim koʻrmaydi, oʻgʻlim. Lekin hisoblarim shu yerda.

scenes.prompt: Close two-shot in the snowy street: the son steadies the old man; the old man, eyes unfocused, calmly taps two fingers against his temple and smiles. Audio: bells fading, soft wind. The son says in Uzbek with a warm, earnest Uzbek male voice, late thirties, worried: "Ota, qo'limni qo'yib yubormang!" The old man answers in Uzbek with an old, gentle, slightly hoarse Uzbek male voice, about sixty-five, kind and unhurried: "Ko'zim ko'rmaydi, o'g'lim. Lekin hisoblarim shu yerda." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Bu — Leonard Eyler. Dunyodagi eng sermahsul matematik. U deyarli butunlay koʻr edi.

scenes.prompt: Slow push-in on the old man's face in candlelight, his clouded eyes looking into the distance. Audio: a single low cello note, a clock ticking. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, deep, warm Uzbek male narrator voice: "Bu — Leonard Eyler. Dunyodagi eng sermahsul matematik. U deyarli butunlay ko'r edi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

In the study, the old man paces slowly beside the desk with one hand raised, dictating; the son dips his quill and writes fast. Audio: quill scratching, candle flicker, footsteps on wood. The old man says in Uzbek with an old, gentle, slightly hoarse Uzbek male voice, about sixty-five, kind and unhurried: "Yoz, o'g'lim. Bugun ko'pyoqlarni sanaymiz." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Sakkizta uch. Oʻn ikkita qirra. Oltita yoq.

scenes.prompt: Close-up: the old man's fingertips slowly travel over the wooden cube, tapping each corner, then sliding along each edge, then pressing each flat face. Audio: soft wooden taps, a quiet counting rhythm. He says in Uzbek with an old, gentle, slightly hoarse Uzbek male voice, about sixty-five, kind and unhurried, slowly counting: "Sakkizta uch. O'n ikkita qirra. Oltita yoq." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Sakkizdan oʻn ikkini ayir, oltini qoʻsh. Ikki chiqdi!

scenes.prompt: The old man raises the cube a little, his face lighting up; behind him the son stops writing and looks up, surprised. Audio: a soft rising string chord, the quill stops. He says in Uzbek with an old, gentle, slightly hoarse Uzbek male voice, about sixty-five, kind and unhurried, delighted: "Sakkizdan o'n ikkini ayir, oltini qo'sh. Ikki chiqdi!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The son picks up the small wooden triangular pyramid and places it in his father's hands; the old man feels its corners and edges quickly, then laughs softly. Audio: a wooden clink, a warm chuckle. The son asks in Uzbek with a warm, earnest Uzbek male voice, late thirties: "Piramidada-chi?" The old man answers in Uzbek with an old, gentle, slightly hoarse Uzbek male voice, about sixty-five, kind and unhurried: "To'rt, olti, to'rt... Yana ikki!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Teshigi yoʻq har qanday koʻpyoqda javob doim ikki. Eyler umri davomida sakkiz yuzdan ortiq ish qoldirdi.

scenes.prompt: Slow pull-back from the candlelit desk: the son writes, the old man stands by the window with the cube in his hand, snow falling outside. Audio: gentle piano, crackling stove. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, deep, warm Uzbek male narrator voice: "Teshigi yo'q har qanday ko'pyoqda javob doim ikki. Eyler umri davomida sakkiz yuzdan ortiq ish qoldirdi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Asosi kvadrat piramidada beshta uch, sakkizta qirra bor. Nechta yoq? Izohda yozing!

scenes.prompt: Medium close-up: the old man turns his face toward the camera as if he can sense the viewer, holding the cube, with a warm knowing smile. Hold on his face at the end. Audio: a single soft bell, candle flicker. He says in Uzbek with an old, gentle, slightly hoarse Uzbek male voice, about sixty-five, kind and unhurried, playful: "Asosi kvadrat piramidada beshta uch, sakkizta qirra bor. Nechta yoq? Izohda yozing!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

post_text_uz: Leonard Eyler deyarli koʻr boʻlib qolgach ham ishlashdan toʻxtamadi — oʻgʻillariga aytib yozdirdi va 800 dan ortiq ish qoldirdi. Uning kashfiyoti: uchlar − qirralar + yoqlar = 2. Savol: asosi kvadrat piramidada 5 uch, 8 qirra bor. Nechta yoq? Izohda yozing! #BuyukKashfiyot #Eyler #matematika #Powerty
